title: okta_app
description: One Okta application (sign-on integration). Whether an app requires MFA is set by its sign-on policy rules, which the okta source does not read, so it omits mfa_required; the sign-on mode alone does not imply MFA.

sign_on_mode.description: Okta sign-on mode: SAML_2_0 | OPENID_CONNECT | SECURE_PASSWORD_STORE | BROWSER_PLUGIN | BASIC_AUTH | AUTO_LOGIN | WS_FEDERATION | …

mfa_required.description: The app's sign-on policy requires MFA. Optional: omitted by sources that do not read sign-on policy rules (the okta source today). Guard with is_set.
